info.description:
Self-hosted toolkit for inspecting and cleaning a Bilibili account.

All write operations are rate-limited (default 1.5 r/s) and retry automatically on -352 / 412 risk-control responses. Long-running cleans are exposed as async tasks under `/api/v2/tasks/*`.

Endpoints under `/api/v2/*` are the canonical AI-facing surface; `/api/clean/*` (v1) are preserved aliases.

post.description:
Background-clear all followings. Equivalent to v1 ``POST /api/clean/followings``
but returns immediately with a task_id.

Sequentially unfollow each mid (B 站 has no batch endpoint). Subject
to the global rate limit — long lists (>50) should use
``POST /followings/unfollow-task`` instead.
post.summary: Unfollow a specific set of mids (synchronous)

post.description:
Start a background unfollow. Poll ``GET /tasks/{task_id}`` for progress.

Recommended for batches >50 since the HTTP client may time out on the
synchronous endpoint.
post.summary: Unfollow many mids as an async task (returns task_id)
